title: Skill Check: Some Considerations on the Evaluation of Gamemastering Models for Role-playing Games

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the pass rates of the models on standardized gamemastering unit tests (commonsense reasoning, item tracking, and map design) when prompted in English versus Spanish.
Qualitative observation of the models' generated narratives and settings to identify an over-representation of specific genres (e.g., medieval-fantasy) resulting from training data imbalances.
